'''Trunk rippers''' were arboreal [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] who tore into [[Tree/Legends|trees]] in search of [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. They could reach lengths of two [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. They had dual foreclaws, a toothed snout, and prehensile tail.<ref name="IHB" />
